title: Thousands separators
description: Write a whole number in decimal with a comma between every group of three digits, counted from the right: 1234567 is "1,234,567" and 1005000 is "1,005,000" (a group in the middle keeps its zeros). Numbers below 1000 get no comma and 0 is "0". A negative number is an error with the message "negative number: N", where N is the number written in the usual way with its minus sign.
notes: Zero-padding of inner groups (1,005,000) is the trap. Negative inputs only reach the error branch, so no division or remainder ever sees a negative operand. Largest test value is below 2^53.
